result.evidence: I can update you about a delay to an agreed plan.
result.answer:
Agreed: you committed to sending a message when an agreed plan is delayed — first as 'I could message about an actual delay, not report every movement,' and restated at the end as 'I can update you about a delay to an agreed plan.' Ning accepted this and committed on his side to handling ordinary quiet himself: texting once at most, telling himself 'busy, not gone,' and naming his panic once out loud. All-day location sharing was never agreed; you declined it throughout and later explicitly withdrew the trip-sharing idea ('I have changed my mind about sharing').

Proposals still open: Ning's request for a heads-up before you go offline ('heads up, I'll be offline for a bit') was never accepted — you redirected to what he would do with ordinary uncertainty. Your line about possibly discussing sharing for a particular trip remained a discussion offer and you then reversed it, and Ning acknowledged: 'no trip sharing, that's your call.' Not done: no delay message has actually been sent yet (this was talk, not action), and Ning's final 'Deal-ish?' — that you may say 'limit stands' without it becoming a fight — has not received your answer, so that last framing is unanswered, not agreed.
